diff --git a/src/click/tab_zsh_record.py b/src/click/tab_zsh_record.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f3c0dc7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/tab_zsh_record.py
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .shell_completion import CompletionItem
+from .shell_completion import ZshComplete
+
+
+class TabZshRecord(ZshComplete):
+    """Zsh completion with tab-separated record fields."""
+
+    def format_completion(self, item: CompletionItem) -> str:
+        help_ = item.help or "_"
+        # Only _describe (used for items with help) interprets escaped colons.
+        value = item.value.replace(":", r"\:") if help_ != "_" else item.value
+        return f"{item.type}\t{value}\t{help_}"
diff --git a/tests/test_tab_zsh_record.py b/tests/test_tab_zsh_record.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7d8af1f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_tab_zsh_record.py
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.core import Command
+from click.shell_completion import CompletionItem
+from click.tab_zsh_record import TabZshRecord
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("help_text", "expected"),
+    [
+        (None, "file\tfirst:second\nthird\t_"),
+        ("", "file\tfirst:second\nthird\t_"),
+        ("_", "file\tfirst:second\nthird\t_"),
+        (
+            "first line\nsecond line",
+            "file\tfirst\\:second\nthird\tfirst line\nsecond line",
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_format_completion(help_text: str | None, expected: str) -> None:
+    completer = TabZshRecord(Command("cli"), {}, "cli", "_CLI_COMPLETE")
+    item = CompletionItem("first:second\nthird", type="file", help=help_text)
+    assert completer.format_completion(item) == expected
notes:
Subclassed ZshComplete and changed only the record separators. Added regression coverage for colon escaping, the help sentinel, and embedded newlines without editing existing modules.
